FAQs

items.q: Do you remove all types of hutches?
a: Yes! We remove all hutch types, including china cabinets, office storage hutches, display cases, and more. Whether antique or modern, large or small, our team can safely remove your hutch.

items.q: Can you disassemble my hutch before removing it?
a: Absolutely. Our professionals will carefully disassemble your hutch if needed, especially for tight spaces or upper floors. We take care to prevent damage to your hutch and property during the process.

items.q: How much does a hutch removal cost?
a: Pricing depends on size and complexity, but we offer free, transparent quotes with no hidden fees. Contact us for an instant estimate tailored to your specific hutch removal needs.

items.q: What areas do you serve for hutch removal?
a: We serve the entire GTA, including Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, and surrounding areas. No location in the Greater Toronto Area is too far for our removal team.

items.q: Do you recycle or donate old hutches?
a: Yes! We prioritize donating usable hutches to local charities. For non-donatable items, we responsibly recycle all possible materials to minimize environmental impact.

items.q: Will you remove a hutch from upper floors or basements?
a: Definitely. Our team is experienced in removing hutches from basements, high-rise apartments, and difficult-to-access spaces. We handle all staircases and elevators professionally.

items.q: Can I schedule a same-day pickup?
a: Often yes! We frequently have same-day availability. Call us in the morning and we’ll do our best to accommodate your urgent hutch removal needs.

items.q: Do I need to empty my hutch before removal?
a: Please remove all contents beforehand. Our team will handle the hutch itself, including any required disassembly, moving, and cleanup after removal.
